Method of Attack: Force-installation of browser extensions that redirect search results to promote unwanted software, fake giveaways, surveys, adult games, dating sites, and other irrelevant results
Distribution via malicious websites promising free downloads of copyrighted media
Execution of VBScripts that run PowerShell scripts to set up scheduled tasks for persistence
Downloading and saving malicious PowerShell scripts into the registry
Injection of adverts on visited websites and search query redirections
Prevention of user access to Chrome extensions screen and redirection to Chrome settings
Use of looping scripts and scheduled tasks to reinstall the extension after removal or reboot
Attack Vector: Malicious websites distributing VBScripts and PowerShell scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Redirects to ythingamgladt[.]com and then Bing search results
